name: Teen Experience and Leadership Program (TELP)
what_you_do: Spend 7 summer weeks at Grady hospital. You rotate through clinical and non-clinical areas, shadow health workers, do labs and workshops, and get a mentor. You can also join a research project and present it.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 19 who have completed 9th grade and want to learn about health care careers. The page lists no residency rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The FAQ says TELP is an unpaid educational program and you get documentation of your service hours.
duration: 7 weeks. In 2026 it ran May 26 to July 14, plus 20 hours of virtual learning labs and 40 hours of community engagement a year.
deadline_text: The 2026 application was open Jan 16 to Feb 20, 2026, with the YouScience assessment Feb 23 to Mar 8 and interviews Mar 9 to 27. 2027 dates are not posted; expect a similar January opening.
how_to_apply: Online application with a headshot, immunization record, media release form signed by a parent or guardian, and a volunteer acknowledgment form. Then take the YouScience career assessment and do an interview. Competitive.
notes: The page says the application period is closed. Accepted teens must get a TB blood test before orientation. Free virtual open houses ran on Tuesdays and Thursdays during the 2026 application window. Late or incomplete applications may not be reviewed.
